content: अध्यारूढ {%<ab>p. p.</ab>%} .²1 Mounted, ascended. .²2 Raised above, elevated. .²3 Above, superior to, more than (with <ab>instr.</ab>); below, inferior; ततोऽध्यारूढानां पदमसुजनद्वेषजननम् <ls>Mu. 5. 12</ls> of those in high office; आयुधपरिग्रहं यावदध्यारूढो दुर्योगः <ls>U. 6</ls> my insolence went the length of taking up arms.
